When used in a stable this will bring up a targeting cursor.  Click the pet you want to stable.
Locks down a container in your house and makes it secure.  Only the owner and co-owners of a house may use this command.
Removes lockdown and secure status of an item.  Only the owner and co-owners of a house may use this command.
Locks down an item in your house.  Only the owner, co-owners and friends of a house may use this command.
I wish to place a trash barrel.

This command will place a trash barrel inside your house at the position you are standing.  Only the owner and co-owners of a house may use this command.  Owners, co-owners and friends may put trash into the barrel.  After three minutes the trash will be deleted.
When used in a stable this command will report how many stable slots are occupied.

Tracks the position of five ships in range of 200 tiles per 60 seconds and shows a marker for each of them on the map.

Target the follower with the lowest health.

Targets the party member with the lowest health.

Target the first item inside target container.
You must first pick the container current target (like with a stored object action) and make sure the container is open.

NOTE: The first item is always the first item placed inside the container and NOT the first on the grid.

Note: This function will only work with macros and it will target only items inside your backpack (or sub-containers).
